Card Q&A.a: No. “For each color” refers to unique colors.  Blue is a single color, so the effect only grants +1000 DP.
Card Q&A.q: If I have 4 blue cards in my digivolution cards, does this card’s [Your Turn] effect grant +4000 DP?

Effect: [When Digivolving] If a Digimon card with [Free] in its traits is in this Digimon's digivolution cards, unsuspend this Digimon and suspend 1 of your opponent's Digimon.
[Your Turn] For each color in this Digimon's digivolution cards, it gets +1000 DP.
